en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an early 20th‑century cargo steamship underway on a calm waterway. The ship has a tall central funnel with a small emblem on it, two masts with rigging, and is loaded with lumber stacked high along the deck. The name "HELFRID" is painted in large letters on the side of the hull near the bow. A small flag is visible at the stern, and the distant shoreline with low buildings and trees appears in the background under an overcast sky.
